scenes.title: Purpose
scenes.narration: VidSearch is a lightweight multimodal video understanding and retrieval engine. It extracts key frames from video clips using ffmpeg, computes dense vector embeddings, builds a fast Faiss vector index. It provides Frame Extraction: vidsearch.frames samples video keyframes with ffmpeg.
